caption: The drawing depicts a mantle clock with a circular face and Roman numerals from I to XII marking the hours. The clock has two black hands, with the hour hand pointing at X (10) and the minute hand at VII (35). The body of the clock is a combination of warm brown, tan, and ochre hues, giving it a wooden or marble appearance. The main circular body sits atop a rectangular base, which is also decorated in similar brownish tones. The clock face is encircled by two concentric rings in alternating light and dark brown segments. On each side of the base, beneath the circular face, are two spiral, volute-shaped decorations in matching brown shades. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small pencil sketch that provides a simple side profile outline of the clock's shape. The drawing is contained within a faint, hand-drawn rectangular border. At the lower left, "Manuel G. Buaignak" is written, and in the lower right, "1 1/2 to 1" is inscribed.
title: Shelf Clock
